english.note: Use 一撻撻 as the all-purpose colloquial choice for irregular patches or spots of colour.
Use this when something is visibly covered in separate patches or blotches.

examples.english: The wall is mottled and looks really dirty.
examples.traditional: 塊牆身一撻撻咁，睇落好污糟。
examples.jyutping: faai3 coeng4 san1 jat1 taat3 taat3 gam3 tai2 lok6 hou2 wu1 zou1

examples.english: My white shirt got patchy from bleach.
examples.traditional: 我件白恤衫俾漂白水整到一撻撻。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gin6 baak6 seot1 saam1 bei2 piu3 baak6 seoi2 zing2 dou3 jat1 taat3 taat3
